what_this_is: A provider description for tools/start-a-computer names: DNS zones and records at Hetzner DNS, reached through the Hetzner Cloud API (https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1/zones). Name this file in a name record's provider. The zone is the domain name (Hetzner accepts a name in place of a zone id). Records are read and changed as RRsets: one RRset is one name and type with its values, and the values are the records. The credential is the vault handle hetzner-api-token (never its value), sent as a bearer header to api.hetzner.cloud only. Routes come from the public Hetzner Cloud OpenAPI spec (docs.hetzner.cloud/cloud.spec.json, read 2026-11-22). This file does not move nameservers: the nameservers a new zone is handed back are read by read_zone, and the registrar change is made by the owner of the names rows.
name: Hetzner DNS

list_zones.notes: The zones of the Hetzner Cloud project, a page at a time. Reads only; the scope check uses it.

find_zone.notes: The zone with one exact name, or none. Reads only.

read_zone.notes: One zone with its nameservers: authoritative_nameservers.assigned is the list a new zone is handed, to be set at the registrar. Reads only.

create_zone.notes: Create one primary zone for a domain the person owns, with the default record TTL of 60 seconds. Creates no records; read_zone then returns the nameservers.

list_records.notes: The RRsets of one zone, a page at a time; each RRset carries its values under records. Reads only.

create_record.notes: Create one A RRset at a name with one value (the machine's address) and the shortest TTL, 60 seconds. Fails if the RRset already exists; add_record then adds a value to it.

add_record.notes: Add one value to an existing A RRset (the RRset is found by its name and type).

remove_record.notes: Remove one value from an A RRset. The provider keeps no record ids: the value is the key.
